claim: ForgeSight checkpoint is short-term execution persistence rather than cross-session long-term memory.
A five-layer memory model is an engineering synthesis of working, short-term, semantic, episodic and procedural memory, not a universal industry standard.
LangMem is the closest integration fit because ForgeSight already uses LangGraph and PostgreSQL.
Graphiti is most relevant when temporal validity and relationship history become first-class requirements.
ForgeSight should keep governed procedural skills separate from episodic and semantic memories.
